visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A Shiba Inu dog with a smiling expression sits on a wooden picnic table. It wears a colorful floral pink bandana and a blue harness. To its left is a white thermos, and to its right is a black retractable leash. The setting is a park filled with vibrant pink cherry blossom trees in full bloom under a bright blue sky. (2) The camera pulls back to a wide shot showing three middle-aged women standing in front of the dog. They are dressed in outdoor vests and sun hats, holding smartphones to photograph the dog. One woman is in a partial squatting position to get a better angle. The background reveals a rolling green hillside with more flowering trees and mountains in the far distance. (3) The shot returns to a vibrant close-up of the Shiba Inu's face. The dog has its mouth open in a happy grin with its tongue out. The background is a soft, dreamlike blur of pink cherry blossoms, emphasizing the bright, sunny lighting of the spring season.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, cheerful glockenspiel melody accompanied by soft percussive beats. A female voice speaks with high pitch and warm tone, sounding like a narrator. (2) A sharp, digital camera shutter SFX triggers. Immediately, the sound of multiple female voices laughing and cheering arises. One voice is dominant, shouting 'Wa!' and then asking the dog to look towards them with high arousal and a rising pitch contour. (3) Continued bright BGM persists while voices continue to praise the subject. A final camera shutter SFX sounds, marking a peak in vocal excitement with various women saying 'So great' and 'You are so good' in Mandarin. The audio maintains a high Signal-To-Noise ratio despite the field recording nature, with clean vocal projection over the melodic background music.
